ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What gets energy from the sun?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: At the bottom center of the figure, a sun is drawn, and multiple arrows emitted by the sun respectively point to boxes labeled “Producer”. The figure also has labels such as “Primary consumer”, “Secondary consumer”, “Tertiary consumer”, and “Decomposers”, but the arrows directly starting from the sun point to producers. Reasoning: In a food chain or energy flow diagram, arrows indicate energy flowing from the source to the receiver. Because the arrows from the sun point to “Producer”, the ones that obtain energy from the sun are producers.
